protocol.sample: per seed, the same capped sample of Monday-Wednesday as the benchmark
protocol.split: 10-minute blocks: 20% of blocks are test blocks (their normal flows are the test normals), the rest goes 80% / 20% to train / validation
protocol.held_out: all rows of the held-out type or category go to the test set and are removed from train and validation; scaler and thresholds never see them
protocol.thresholds: max F1, and 1% / 5% false alarms on validation normals, as in evaluate.py
